d:
Presenting Ustad Vilayat Khan Memorial Concert on the occasion of his first death anniversary at London's Royal Festival Hall on 27 th Feb 2005.
Commencing with a personal tribute by his eldest son, Ustad Shujaat Khan (Sitar), the event comprised of tribute performances by Pandit Shivkumar Sharma (Santoor) & Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia (Bansuri), a duet recital, followed by a Hindustani khayal recital by the Ganasaraswati Smt Kishori Amonkar.
